Watts made this hymn from Psalm 110, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

1The LORD said to my Lord: “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.” 2The LORD extends Your mighty scepter from Zion: “Rule in the midst of Your enemies.” 3Your people shall be willing on Your day of battle. Arrayed in holy splendor, from the womb of the dawn, to You belongs the dew of Your youth. 4The LORD has sworn and will not change His mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.” … 3 more verses PSALM 110 · ITS FIRST VERSES · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 110
